of.needed: whether the static configuration file (YAML/TOML) contains a pilot section

consequence.statement: Traefik will not start if any Pilot configuration remains in the static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Pilot related configuration from the static configuration.

assertion.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key removed
